checks.question: Revise the supplied flanged hub so its six mounting holes lie outside the neck. Replace the old six cuts with six diameter-4.3 mm through-holes, equally spaced on a 33.0 mm pitch circle, preserving the original angular phase. Fill the obsolete cuts, including the grooves they left in the neck. Increase the central bore from diameter 10.8 to 12.5 mm. Increase the flange thickness from 2.5 to 4.0 mm upward from its unchanged bottom plane. Keep the flange outside diameter 42.5 mm, neck outside diameter 21.52 mm and overall height 27.4 mm. Retain 0.4 mm chamfers at the top and bottom edge sets, adapting their topology to the new bores. The final hub must be one closed connected solid with six separate open mounting holes and an uninterrupted neck wall around the central bore.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
